title: isolved pricing - Starts at $9.00, fully customized by modules and employee count
clean_text: According to G2 data, isolved pricing starts at $9.00, but is fully customized depending on chosen modules, employee count, and services -- isolved does not offer a free plan or free trial. G2 reviews describe the add-on pricing as "cafeteria-style," meaning costs can escalate quickly as additional modules are layered on, and some reviewers report unexpected price increases or, after acquisitions of reseller partners, effectively doubled rates.
